title: Revel Carbon Frame Factory Tour
content:
Revel just posted its full-length carbon factory tour. The team at Revel has dedicated their careers to figuring out how to make the best quality bikes, and historically the brand has kept a lot of the manufacturing side of things under wraps. So, on its last visit to its carbon manufacturer, Revel brought its friends from ‪Dream Build Bikes along to film some of what goes on behind the scenes to make Revel’s carbon bikes…

The post Revel Carbon Frame Factory Tour appeared first on The Radavist.
author: John Watson
